faculty_group: Regular faculty and staff members of the University of North Texas are entitled to a sick leave allowance as provided by the Texas Government Code.
eligible_parent: When the employee's performance of duty is prevented by sickness, injury, pregnancy and confinement, or exposure to contagious diseases which require quarantine or isolation.

For example, a state employee, who is the father of a child, may use his sick leave in conjunction with the child's birth only if the child is actually ill or to care for his spouse while she is recovering from labor and delivery.

An employee who adopts a child under three years of age is to be treated as if he or she had undergone pregnancy and childbirth. Therefore, an employee who adopts a child under three years of age may use the amount of sick leave that would be necessary to recover from pregnancy and childbirth.

service_requirement: Sick leave entitlement accrues from the first day of employment and terminates on the last day of duty.
medical_certification: To be eligible for accumulated sick leave with pay during a continuous period of more than three (3) working days, an employee who has been absent must provide a medical practitioner's statement showing the cause or nature of the illness, or some written statement of the facts concerning the illness, which is acceptable to the departmental official.
time_window: For example, a state employee, who is the father of a child, may use his sick leave in conjunction with the child's birth only if the child is actually ill or to care for his spouse while she is recovering from labor and delivery.

An employee who adopts a child under three years of age is to be treated as if he or she had undergone pregnancy and childbirth. Therefore, an employee who adopts a child under three years of age may use the amount of sick leave that would be necessary to recover from pregnancy and childbirth.
sequence: An eligible employee may elect, or an employer may require the employee, to substitute any of the accrued paid vacation leave, personal leave, or medical or sick leave of the employee for leave provided under subparagraph (C) or (D) of subsection (a)(1) for any part of the 12-week period of such leave under such subsection
duration_note: Regular full-time employees shall earn sick leave entitlement at the rate of eight (8) hours for each month or fraction of a month of paid employment.

notes: Six of the seven sources are policy-office description pages whose full policy PDFs were not saved (05.061, 05.064, 05.069, 06.011, 06.004; 05.050's PDF is saved as 2018_04). Only 05.050 Sick Leave is saved in full. The description pages state each policy's summary, 'Applies to', date issued and revision history; their revision histories show no change between their last revision and the reference date 2018-03-12. 06.004 (tenure and promotion framework) holds no leave provision.

U8 path: UNT 05.061 Parental Leave (up to 12 weeks, unpaid apart from required use of vacation and sick leave, for faculty and staff with under 12 months of state service or under 1,250 hours) is the path for employees who are not FMLA-eligible. The member the figures describe is FMLA-eligible, so FMLA (c1) is coded and 05.061 is recorded in c1's duration_note.

Chain, birth parent: FMLA leave 12 workweeks (c1), with own accrued sick leave (c2, pregnancy and confinement) paid within it; when paid leave is exhausted, possibly the Sick Leave Pool (c3) or Administrative Leave with Pay (c4), both discretionary and of unstated length, then a discretionary general leave without pay (c5/c6, general purpose, uncounted). The temporary disability plan (c7) has no stated length.
Chain, non-birth parent: FMLA leave 12 workweeks (c1); own sick leave (c2) usable within it only if the child is ill or to care for the spouse recovering from labor and delivery.
No term length or calendar kind is stated in the saved documents; calendar omitted.

Cited but not saved: full policy PDFs of 05.061 Parental Leave, 05.064 Family and Medical Leave, 05.069 Leave of Absence without Pay, 06.011 Faculty Leaves of Absence Without Pay, 06.004 Reappointment, Tenure and Promotion; 05.051 Sick Leave Pooling; 05.066 Emergency/Administrative Leave; 05.052 Disciplinary Action Related to Sick Leave; Absence/Attendance; Workers' Compensation Insurance; Return to Work; Time Period Exclusion from the Probationary Period; the Uniform Group Insurance Plan; Texas Government Code ch. 661 subch. G and 661.034/.067/.151/.203; State Employees Workers Compensation Act art. 309g. Vacation and compensatory leave are named in 05.050 IX for staff members only; no vacation policy is saved and no faculty vacation provision is stated, so no component.
